blind.description: A wooden combat training dummy mounted on a four-legged timber cross base secured with rope. The dummy has a rounded wooden head topped with a metal helmet featuring a central ridge, and wears a stitched green padded tunic with a red belt and orange frayed cuffs. Its left arm ends in an open frayed sleeve, while its right arm holds an upright wooden practice sword.
blind.from_above: A rounded metallic helmet with a central crest flanked by two outstretched wooden arms (one holding a wooden sword), over a green tunic with a wooden four-legged base visible beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 feet tall to the top of the helmet (roughly 5 feet to the sword tip) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide across the arms, standing somewhat shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure.
